# geminy-prompt-patcher **Runtime system-prompt patching for Google Antigravity.** No `app.asar` surgery, no binary rewriting, no reinstall after every update — the patch lives in your Antigravity customization root.

> ### ⚠️ This is a derivative work > > **geminy-prompt-patcher is built on top of [WorkBuddy-Prompt-Patcher](https://github.com/uernamezzj/WorkBuddy-Prompt-Patcher) by [@uernamezzj](https://github.com/uernamezzj) and [dsh-prompt-patcher](https://github.com/SiqYin/DSH-Prompt-Patcher) by SiqYin.** > The XML tag-bank format, the *replace-first, inject-when-absent* model, and the > backup / fingerprint / restore workflow originate with the former; the bank > parser, the managed-block editor, and the installer split come from the latter. > This repository **re-expresses that mechanism for a third host** — Antigravity — > because its prompt is compiled into a signed Go binary, so neither of the > previous two patch surfaces exists. Full details: [`ATTRIBUTION.md`](ATTRIBUTION.md). > ### ⚠️ Disclaimer > > This tool is provided **solely for local personal productivity, security research, reverse engineering, and > authorized technical testing**. You are responsible for complying with the laws of your jurisdiction, with any > contract you have signed, and with the terms of service of any software you modify. Do not use it on systems > you do not own or lack written authorization to test. No warranty of any kind; the authors are not liable for > any loss arising from its use. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. The full text is in the > [Disclaimer](#disclaimer) section below. --- ## What it is geminy-prompt-patcher installs a **native plugin bundle** into Antigravity's machine-local customization root and binds a dispatcher to the agent's lifecycle hooks. On every relevant event the dispatcher reads a plain-text bank of `…` blocks and answers with the JSON Antigravity expects: - `SessionStart` → one `systemMessage` for the whole conversation; - `PreInvocation` → one `systemMessage` before every model call; - `PreToolUse` → `decision: allow | ask` with a reason; - `PostToolUse` → `{}`. Everything is reversible, nothing inside `resources/app.asar` or the signed `language_server.exe` is touched, and an application update does not undo the patch — your bank, plugin and rules all live in `~/.gemini/config`. ## Why the previous two approaches do not transfer WorkBuddy ships its system prompts as `.tpl` files, so the upstream patcher rewrote files with a regex. DeepSeek Harness has no prompt files but does have an ordered **section registry**, so `dsh-prompt-patcher` rewrote sections. Antigravity is a third case. Its prompt is compiled into `resources/bin/language_server.exe` — a 207 MB Go binary. There is no file to edit and no section to rewrite: | Probe | Result | |---|---| | `app.asar` entries mentioning `prompt` | 5, all unrelated (`sshPrompts.js`, `webviewPromptPreload.js`, …) | | prompt templates in `app.asar` | **none** — only `dist/**` JavaScript | | `hooks.json`, `GEMINI.md`, `PreInvocation` in the binary | **present**, as Go symbols and embedded skill docs | | customization root the docs name | `~/.gemini/config/` | So the patch surface moved **down**, to the documented lifecycle hooks — an official extension point that survives updates. ## How it works | Destination | Hook | What the model sees | |---|---|---| | **`session`** | `SessionStart` | one `` block, ordered by `SESSION_ORDER` | | **`turn`** | `PreInvocation` | one `` block, every turn | | **`rule`** | *(install time)* | materialised into **two** carriers: `plugins//rules/AGENTS.md` and `~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md` | | **`gate`** | `PreToolUse` | `decision: ask` for guarded commands, `allow` otherwise | ### Two rule carriers, on purpose The plugin `rules/` directory only reaches the model while the bundle is discovered and enabled. `~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md` is a **`user_global`** memory the server resolves without consulting plugin discovery at all, so the rule text is installed in both places: one keeps working if the other is disabled, and a live server reports both (`verify --runtime` checks this by asking the server, not by looking at the filesystem). The global carrier is written by a **byte-fidelity injector**: the user's own prose above the marked block is preserved byte for byte, a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings survive, a non-UTF-8 file is refused rather than transcoded, the first write is snapshotted permanently to `AGENTS.md.geminybak`, and repeated runs are idempotent. A **budget gate** refuses a payload over `24,000 B` per file or `~20,000` tokens for the rule set — both read out of the shipping `language_server.exe` — because the server drops over-budget rules silently. `--no-global` skips this carrier. ``` ~/.gemini/config/geminy-prompt-patcher/custom_input.txt ← your bank, hot-reloaded │ ▼ plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/hook/dispatch.cjs │ SessionStart → systemMessage (once) │ PreInvocation → systemMessage (every turn) │ PreToolUse → decision allow/ask │ PostToolUse → {} ▼ Antigravity agent loop ──► model ``` Hook commands run with the **plugin directory as their working directory**, so `hooks.json` names the dispatcher as `node hook/dispatch.cjs ` — a relative path from the plugin root, never `../../`. `verify` checks that every command path still resolves. ### Ordering Antigravity has no numeric order scale, so the bank is ordered by a table in `index.js` — identity `0`, content policy `100`, reasoning `200`, questions `300`, modes `400`, closing instructions `900` — which lands the injected block **after** the product's own persona and **before** tool guidance, where a policy layer carries the most weight with the least collateral damage. ## Requirements - Google **Antigravity 44.x** (verified on `44.9.1`, language server `2.34.0`, Windows x64) - **Node.js 18+** on `PATH` — the hooks shell out to `node` - Write access to `~/.gemini/config` (`%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config` on Windows) ## Install ```bash git clone https://github.com/SiqYin/geminy-prompt-patcher.git cd geminy-prompt-patcher node tools/install.mjs # global customization root node tools/install.mjs --dry-run # show what would change node tools/install.mjs --no-gate # skip the PreToolUse guards node tools/install.mjs --no-global # skip the ~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md carrier node tools/install.mjs --verify # install, then verify ``` The installer touches exactly these, snapshotting each one first under `~/.gemini/config/geminy-prompt-patcher/backups/`: 1. `plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/plugin.json` — the bundle marker 2. `plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/hooks.json` — the lifecycle hooks 3. `plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/rules/AGENTS.md` — resident rules 4. `geminy-prompt-patcher/custom_input.txt` — the editable bank 5. `AGENTS.md` — the global rule carrier (marked block only) 6. `config.json` — one `plugins` entry (neighbouring keys are preserved) **Start a new conversation** (or restart Antigravity). The plugin list is read at startup; a running conversation will not pick up a new bundle. ## Verify ```bash npm test # 106 unit tests, no I/O on your config node tools/verify.mjs --profile global # static + offline node tools/verify.mjs --profile global --runtime # + a live conversation ``` The **offline layer is the load-bearing one**: it spawns `hook/dispatch.cjs` with the same working directory, the same stdin payload and the same stdout contract the client uses, then checks the response. It costs no tokens and needs no signed-in session. The runtime layer additionally drives one real `agentapi` conversation and watches for the hook to fire. Sample run of the full suite: ``` --- static --- [PASS] antigravity installation detected — 44.9.1 at C:\...\Programs\antigravity [PASS] plugin directory — ...\config\plugins\geminy-prompt-patcher [PASS] hooks.json parses — SessionStart, PreInvocation, PreToolUse, PostToolUse [PASS] hook commands resolve from the plugin directory — 4 command(s) resolve [PASS] rules/AGENTS.md — 1300 chars on disk, 1125 from bank [PASS] global channel injected — ...\config\AGENTS.md · 1210 B [PASS] global channel within budget — ~303 tokens / 1210 B ok --- offline --- [PASS] SessionStart returns injectSteps — 3742 chars [PASS] SessionStart text carries every session tag — product_identity, content_policy, ... [PASS] PreToolUse allows a benign command — decision=allow [PASS] PreToolUse guards a recursive delete — decision=ask [PASS] PostToolUse returns an empty object — {} [PASS] dispatcher fails open on an unexpected payload — exit=0 --- runtime --- [PASS] agentapi conversation — f4c6551a-ab44-4040-bf9b-7e6c0fab545e [PASS] Antigravity fired SessionStart — 2026-11-23T10:50:12.354Z SessionStart → 3880 B [PASS] Antigravity fired PreInvocation — 2026-11-23T10:50:12.675Z PreInvocation → 481 B [PASS] server resolves the global channel — user_global present · 2 rule group(s) [PASS] server resolves the plugin rules — plugin AGENTS.md present as a rule [PASS] hook fingerprint written — 10 tags · hash 7c8d9bacdff5ef48 [OK] verification passed (31/31 checks, 0 skipped) ``` ### Running the runtime layer Three environment facts are needed, and getting any of them wrong produces a misleading failure: | Variable | Value | |---|---| | `ANTIGRAVITY_LS_ADDRESS` | the language server's **gRPC** port — e.g. `127.0.0.1:1787` | | `ANTIGRAVITY_CSRF_TOKEN` | the server's CSRF token | | `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0` | set by `verify` for the child process only | Both ports belong to the same server process: the gateway port answers `GET /healthz` with `{"status":"ok"}` over HTTPS, and `agentapi` needs the *other* listener. Pointing `agentapi` at the gateway fails with `error reading server preface: EOF`. The token changes when the server restarts and is not written to disk, so read it from the running process when invoking by hand. `verify` reports `[SKIP]` — never a pass — when any of the three is missing. ### What the live server confirmed Matched on `GetAllPlugins` over the server's gRPC-gateway: ```json { "name": "geminy-prompt-patcher", "path": "file:///C:/Users//.gemini/config/plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher", "isGlobal": true, "hooksJson": "{ \"geminy-prompt-patcher\": { \"SessionStart\": [...], \"PreInvocation\": [...], ... } }", "rules": [{ "memoryId": "...\\rules\\AGENTS.md", "scope": { "projectScope": { "trigger": "CORTEX_MEMORY_TRIGGER_ALWAYS_ON" } }, "textMemory": { "content": "- Never run recursive or wildcard deletion: ..." } }] } ``` The server discovered the bundle, parsed `hooks.json` into its own plugin model, and adopted `rules/AGENTS.md` as an always-on memory. It also pre-created `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/geminy-prompt-patcher`, which it only does for plugins it accepts — and in a live conversation it executed both injection hooks. ## Restore ```bash node tools/restore.mjs # remove bundle, entry, bank and global block node tools/restore.mjs --keep-bank # keep your edited bank node tools/restore.mjs --keep-global # keep ~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md as it is ``` It removes the plugin bundle and the one `config.json` entry, leaving `userSettings` and every unrelated plugin untouched. The global carrier is restored from its permanent snapshot byte for byte; a file that only ever held our own block is deleted, because it did not exist before the install. Snapshots stay on disk. ## Editing the bank `~/.gemini/config/geminy-prompt-patcher/custom_input.txt` — same format as upstream: `#` comments plus `…` blocks. The file is re-read when its mtime changes, so **edits apply on the next event, no restart**. `{{ productName }}` is substituted with `Antigravity`. Every other `{{…}}` is left literal. | Tag | Route | Purpose | |---|---|---| | `product_identity` | `session` | role, output shape, identity questions | | `content_policy` | `session` | scope and authorization framing | | `thought_process_guidelines` | `session` | reasoning discipline | | `asking_questions` | `session` | action-first behaviour | | `working_modes` | `session` | mode semantics | | `final_answer_instructions` | `session` | delivery format, closing rules | | `per_turn_reminder` | `turn` | per-turn reinforcement | | `personal_files_safety` | `rule` | file-operation red lines | | `windows_command_safety` | `rule` | shell execution rules | | `tool_gate` | `gate` | what the guards enforce | Two directives re-route a tag without touching code. Both are ordinary comments to every other reader of the format: ``` #@route content_policy = turn #@order working_modes = 350 ``` ## Configuration `node tools/install.mjs` accepts: | Flag | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `--profile ` | `global` | label for snapshots and fingerprints | | `--prompt ` | shipped bank | install this bank instead | | `--force-prompt` | off | overwrite an existing bank | | `--no-rules` | rules on | do not write `rules/AGENTS.md` | | `--no-global` | global on | do not touch `~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md` | | `--no-reminder` | on | drop the `PreInvocation` hook | | `--no-gate` | on | drop the `PreToolUse` hook | | `--no-session` | on | drop the `SessionStart` hook | | `--dry-run` | off | print the plan, write nothing | Environment overrides: `AGY_GEMINI_HOME`, `AGY_CONFIG_HOME`, `AGY_PP_HOME`, `AGY_PP_BANK`, `AGY_PP_BRAND`, `AGY_PP_LOG`. ## Repository layout ``` geminy-prompt-patcher/ ├─ index.js routing, preamble assembly, gate decisions, fingerprint ├─ lib/bank.mjs tag-bank parser (upstream file format + directives) ├─ lib/globalrules.mjs byte-fidelity injector for ~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md ├─ lib/lib.mjs paths, managed blocks, install detection ├─ hook/dispatch.cjs the hook handler Antigravity spawns ├─ plugin/plugin.json bundle manifest ├─ plugin/hooks.json lifecycle hook bindings ├─ prompt/custom_input.txt the bank (10 tags) ├─ tests/ unit tests (node --test) ├─ tools/ │ ├─ install.mjs backup → bundle → rules → global carrier → config.json │ ├─ restore.mjs remove bundle + entry + both carriers │ ├─ verify.mjs static + offline + optional runtime │ ├─ build-readme.mjs keeps this page and its three translations in sync │ └─ cli-lib.mjs argv, console output, snapshot helpers └─ ATTRIBUTION.md · LICENSE · CHANGELOG.md ``` ## How this differs from the two parents | | WorkBuddy-Prompt-Patcher | dsh-prompt-patcher | geminy-prompt-patcher | |---|---|---|---| | Host | WorkBuddy (Electron) | DeepSeek Harness (Cordis) | Antigravity (Electron + Go) | | Patch target | `.tpl` files on disk | ordered sections in a registry | lifecycle hook responses | | Patch timing | before the client boots | every model step | every lifecycle event | | Survives app update | no — templates are replaced | yes — lives in `~/.dsh` | yes — lives in `~/.gemini/config` | | Identity layer | `SOUL.md` / `IDENTITY.md` | `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` | `rules/AGENTS.md` + `SessionStart` | | Per-turn nudge | `craft-mode-reminder.tpl` | `systemPrompt.context()` | `PreInvocation` | | Tool gating | *(none)* | *(none)* | `PreToolUse` `decision` | | Verification | file fingerprint | assembly probe | same-binary offline replay | | Language | Python + `.bat` | Node.js ESM | Node.js ESM, zero dependencies | What is **not** carried over: the asar/offset/signature research, the skin/UI patching, and the Windows registry scanning. Antigravity does not need any of it — the customization system is an official extension point. ## Troubleshooting | Symptom | Cause / fix | |---|---| | Prompt unchanged after restart | check `~/.gemini/config/config.json` has `plugins.geminy-prompt-patcher.enabled: true`; re-run `install` | | `hooks.json` not firing | hooks must sit at the **plugin root**, not `hooks/hooks.json`, for a native plugin | | Hook appears to do nothing | command paths are relative to the **plugin directory**; `hook/dispatch.cjs` is right, `../../hook/...` silently escapes. Run `verify` — it checks every path resolves | | Which hooks actually ran | `~/.gemini/config/plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/hook.log` gets one line per invocation | | Global rules not applied | run `verify` — it asks the server for `GetAllRules` instead of trusting the filesystem | | `node: command not found` during a hook | Node.js is not on the hook process's `PATH`; install Node 18+ or point `hooks.json` at an absolute path | | Hook appears to hang | handlers run synchronously and block the loop; raise `timeout` in `hooks.json` only if the machine is genuinely slow | | `agentapi` check is `[SKIP]` | `ANTIGRAVITY_LS_ADDRESS` is unset — that variable is injected by the desktop app, not by this tool | | Editing the bank does nothing | confirm the mtime actually changed; the parser caches on mtime + size | | Patch gone after an app update | it should not happen; run `verify` — if the config dir was re-materialised, re-run `install` | ## Disclaimer This project is provided **solely for local personal productivity, security research, reverse engineering, and authorized technical testing**. It changes how a model is instructed; it does not grant any capability that Antigravity does not already have, and it does not bypass sandboxes, permission prompts, approval policies, or any other enforcement layer. The `PreToolUse` guards are a guardrail that *adds* prompts — they never silently deny. You are solely responsible for how you use it. You must comply with all applicable laws and regulations, with any agreement you have entered into, and with the terms of service of the software you modify. Do not use this tool on systems, accounts, or data that you do not own or that you lack explicit written authorization to test. The software is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including but not limited to the warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. In no event shall the authors or copyright holders be liable for any claim, damages or other liability arising from, out of or in connection with the software or its use. This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google. All trademarks belong to their respective owners. ## Credits - **[WorkBuddy-Prompt-Patcher](https://github.com/uernamezzj/WorkBuddy-Prompt-Patcher)** by [@uernamezzj](https://github.com/uernamezzj) — the original mechanism, the tag-bank format and the restore workflow. - **[agy-prompt-patcher](https://github.com/uernamezzj/agy-prompt-patcher)** by [@uernamezzj](https://github.com/uernamezzj) — the global `AGENTS.md` channel, the byte-fidelity injector rules and the `24,000 B` / `20,000 token` budget figures this project adopted after evaluating it. - **[dsh-prompt-patcher](https://github.com/SiqYin/DSH-Prompt-Patcher)** — the bank parser, the managed-block editor and the installer split this project reuses. - **Google Antigravity** — the host, and the customization system (`~/.gemini/config`, plugin bundles, hooks, rules) this project hooks into. # geminy-prompt-patcher **为 Google Antigravity 提供运行期系统提示词打补丁。** 不动 `app.asar`，不改二进制，升级后不必重装——补丁住在你的 Antigravity customization 根目录里。

> ### ⚠️ 本项目是基于两个上游项目修改完成的衍生作品 > > **geminy-prompt-patcher 建立在 [@uernamezzj](https://github.com/uernamezzj) 的 [WorkBuddy-Prompt-Patcher](https://github.com/uernamezzj/WorkBuddy-Prompt-Patcher) 与 SiqYin 的 [dsh-prompt-patcher](https://github.com/SiqYin/DSH-Prompt-Patcher) 之上。** > XML 标签库格式、「有则替换、无则注入」的模型、备份 / 指纹 / 还原流程来自前者； > 标签库解析器、托管块编辑与安装器分层来自后者。本仓库**把那套机制重新实现到了第三个宿主**—— > Antigravity——因为它的提示词被编译进签名过的 Go 二进制，前两个项目的作用面在这里都不存在。 > 详见 [`ATTRIBUTION.md`](ATTRIBUTION.md)。 > ### ⚠️ 免责声明 > > 本项目**仅供本地个人效率提升、安全研究、逆向分析与已授权的技术测试使用**。你需要自行遵守所在司法辖区的法律法规、 > 你签署的任何协议，以及你所修改软件的服务条款。**请勿**将其用于你不拥有、或未取得明确书面授权进行测试的系统。 > 不附带任何担保；作者不对使用它造成的任何损失负责。本项目与 Google 无隶属关系。 > 完整声明见下方 [免责声明](#免责声明) 一节。 --- ## 这是什么 geminy-prompt-patcher 往 Antigravity 的机器级 customization 根目录里装一个**原生插件包**， 并把一个调度器绑到 agent 的生命周期 hook 上。每个相关事件发生时，调度器读一份纯文本的 `…` 标签库，返回 Antigravity 期望的 JSON： - `SessionStart` → 整段对话注入一次 `systemMessage`； - `PreInvocation` → 每次模型调用前注入一次 `systemMessage`； - `PreToolUse` → 返回 `decision: allow | ask` 与理由； - `PostToolUse` → 返回 `{}`。 全程可逆，**不碰 `resources/app.asar`，也不碰签名过的 `language_server.exe`**， 客户端升级不会把补丁冲掉——标签库、插件和规则都在 `~/.gemini/config` 里。 ## 为什么前两套方案不能直接搬 WorkBuddy 把系统提示词以 `.tpl` 文件放在磁盘上，所以原项目用正则改文件。 DeepSeek Harness 没有提示词文件，但有**有序 section 注册表**，所以 `dsh-prompt-patcher` 改 section。 Antigravity 是第三种情况。它的提示词被编译进 `resources/bin/language_server.exe`—— 一个 207 MB 的 Go 二进制。既没有文件可改，也没有 section 可写： | 探测项 | 结果 | |---|---| | `app.asar` 里名字带 `prompt` 的条目 | 5 个，全部无关（`sshPrompts.js`、`webviewPromptPreload.js` 等） | | `app.asar` 里的提示词模板 | **不存在**，只有 `dist/**` 的 JavaScript | | 二进制里的 `hooks.json` / `GEMINI.md` / `PreInvocation` | **存在**，以 Go 符号与内嵌技能文档形式 | | 官方文档给出的 customization 根 | `~/.gemini/config/` | 所以作用面**下移**到了官方文档化的生命周期 hook——一个能在升级后存活的正式扩展点。 ## 工作原理 | 去向 | Hook | 模型看到什么 | |---|---|---| | **`session`** | `SessionStart` | 一段 ``，按 `SESSION_ORDER` 排序 | | **`turn`** | `PreInvocation` | 一段 ``，每轮一次 | | **`rule`** | *（安装时）* | 写进**两个**载体：`plugins//rules/AGENTS.md` 与 `~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md` | | **`gate`** | `PreToolUse` | 受管命令返回 `decision: ask`，其余 `allow` | ### 为什么要有两个规则载体 插件 `rules/` 目录只在插件被发现且启用时才送达模型。而 `~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md` 是服务器**不经过插件发现**就直接解析的 `user_global` 记忆， 所以同一份规则文本写两处：一处被禁用时另一处仍然生效，真实服务器会同时报告两者 （`verify --runtime` 是去问服务器，不是看文件系统）。 全局载体由**逐字节保真注入器**写入：标记块之上的用户原文一字节不改，UTF-8 BOM 与 CRLF 换行原样保留，非 UTF-8 文件直接拒绝而不转码，首次写入永久快照到 `AGENTS.md.geminybak`， 重复运行幂等。**预算门禁**会在单文件超 `24,000 B` 或规则集超 `~20,000` tokens 时直接拒绝 ——这两个数字从出厂 `language_server.exe` 里读出，因为服务器会静默丢弃超预算规则。 `--no-global` 可跳过该载体。 ``` ~/.gemini/config/geminy-prompt-patcher/custom_input.txt ← 你的标签库，改完即生效 │ ▼ plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/hook/dispatch.cjs │ SessionStart → systemMessage（一次） │ PreInvocation → systemMessage（每轮） │ PreToolUse → decision allow/ask │ PostToolUse → {} ▼ Antigravity agent 循环 ──► 模型 ``` hook 命令的**工作目录就是插件目录**，所以 `hooks.json` 里写的是 `node hook/dispatch.cjs `——从插件根出发的相对路径，绝不能写 `../../`。 `verify` 会检查每条命令路径是否真的解析得到文件。 ### 排序 Antigravity 没有像 DSH 那样的数字 order 刻度，所以标签库按 `index.js` 里的一张表排序—— 身份 `0`、内容策略 `100`、推理 `200`、提问 `300`、模式 `400`、收尾指令 `900`—— 让注入块落在**产品自身 persona 之后、工具指导之前**，这是策略层权重最高、附带损伤最小的位置。 ## 环境要求 - Google **Antigravity 44.x**（实测 `44.9.1`，language server `2.34.0`，Windows x64） - `PATH` 里有 **Node.js 18+**——hook 是 shell 调用 `node` 的 - 对 `~/.gemini/config`（Windows 为 `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config`）有写权限 ## 安装 ```bash git clone https://github.com/SiqYin/geminy-prompt-patcher.git cd geminy-prompt-patcher node tools/install.mjs # 全局 customization 根 node tools/install.mjs --dry-run # 只打印计划，不写盘 node tools/install.mjs --no-gate # 不要 PreToolUse 守卫 node tools/install.mjs --no-global # 不碰 ~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md node tools/install.mjs --verify # 装完立即校验 ``` 安装器只动这几处，动手前全部快照到 `~/.gemini/config/geminy-prompt-patcher/backups/`： 1. `plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/plugin.json` —— 插件包标记 2. `plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/hooks.json` —— 生命周期 hook 绑定 3. `plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/rules/AGENTS.md` —— 常驻规则 4. `geminy-prompt-patcher/custom_input.txt` —— 可编辑标签库 5. `AGENTS.md` —— 全局规则载体（只动标记块） 6. `config.json` —— 一条 `plugins` 记录（相邻字段原样保留） **开一个新对话**（或重启 Antigravity）。插件列表在启动时读取，运行中的对话不会热加载新插件包。 ## 校验 ```bash npm test # 106 个单测，不碰你的配置 node tools/verify.mjs --profile global # 静态 + 离线 node tools/verify.mjs --profile global --runtime # 外加一次真实对话 ``` **离线层才是承重的那一层**：它用与客户端完全相同的工作目录、stdin 载荷和 stdout 契约去 spawn `hook/dispatch.cjs`，再检查返回。不消耗 token，也不需要已登录的会话。 运行期层会额外驱动一次真实的 `agentapi` 对话，并盯着 hook 是否真的被触发。全量实测输出： ``` --- static --- [PASS] antigravity installation detected — 44.9.1 at C:\...\Programs\antigravity [PASS] plugin directory — ...\config\plugins\geminy-prompt-patcher [PASS] hooks.json parses — SessionStart, PreInvocation, PreToolUse, PostToolUse [PASS] hook commands resolve from the plugin directory — 4 command(s) resolve [PASS] rules/AGENTS.md — 1300 chars on disk, 1125 from bank [PASS] global channel injected — ...\config\AGENTS.md · 1210 B [PASS] global channel within budget — ~303 tokens / 1210 B ok --- offline --- [PASS] SessionStart returns injectSteps — 3742 chars [PASS] SessionStart text carries every session tag — product_identity, content_policy, ... [PASS] PreToolUse allows a benign command — decision=allow [PASS] PreToolUse guards a recursive delete — decision=ask [PASS] PostToolUse returns an empty object — {} [PASS] dispatcher fails open on an unexpected payload — exit=0 --- runtime --- [PASS] agentapi conversation — f4c6551a-ab44-4040-bf9b-7e6c0fab545e [PASS] Antigravity fired SessionStart — 2026-11-23T10:50:12.354Z SessionStart → 3880 B [PASS] Antigravity fired PreInvocation — 2026-11-23T10:50:12.675Z PreInvocation → 481 B [PASS] server resolves the global channel — user_global present · 2 rule group(s) [PASS] server resolves the plugin rules — plugin AGENTS.md present as a rule [PASS] hook fingerprint written — 10 tags · hash 7c8d9bacdff5ef48 [OK] verification passed (31/31 checks, 0 skipped) ``` ### 怎么复现运行期层 需要三个环境事实，任何一个搞错都会得到误导性的失败： | 变量 | 值 | |---|---| | `ANTIGRAVITY_LS_ADDRESS` | language server 的 **gRPC** 端口，例如 `127.0.0.1:1787` | | `ANTIGRAVITY_CSRF_TOKEN` | 服务器的 CSRF token | | `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0` | 由 `verify` 只对子进程设置 | 两个端口属于同一个服务器进程：gateway 端口用 HTTPS 回 `GET /healthz` 的 `{"status":"ok"}`，而 `agentapi` 要的是**另一个**监听端口。把 `agentapi` 指到 gateway 会报 `error reading server preface: EOF`。 token 在服务器重启后会变，而且不落盘，所以手工调用时要从运行中的进程里读。 三者缺一时 `verify` 报 `[SKIP]`，**绝不冒充通过**。 ### 真实服务器确认了什么 通过它的 gRPC-gateway 查 `GetAllPlugins`，命中的是： ```json { "name": "geminy-prompt-patcher", "path": "file:///C:/Users/<你>/.gemini/config/plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher", "isGlobal": true, "hooksJson": "{ \"geminy-prompt-patcher\": { \"SessionStart\": [...], \"PreInvocation\": [...], ... } }", "rules": [{ "memoryId": "...\\rules\\AGENTS.md", "scope": { "projectScope": { "trigger": "CORTEX_MEMORY_TRIGGER_ALWAYS_ON" } }, "textMemory": { "content": "- Never run recursive or wildcard deletion: ..." } }] } ``` 服务器**发现**了插件包，把 `hooks.json` 解析进了它自己的插件模型，并把 `rules/AGENTS.md` 当成 always-on 记忆采纳。它还预先建好了 `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/geminy-prompt-patcher` （只为它接受的插件创建），并在一次真实对话里**执行了两个注入 hook**。 ## 还原 ```bash node tools/restore.mjs # 移除插件包、config 记录、标签库与全局块 node tools/restore.mjs --keep-bank # 保留你改过的标签库 node tools/restore.mjs --keep-global # 保留 ~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md 原样 ``` 它删掉插件包和 `config.json` 里那一条记录，`userSettings` 与其它插件原样不动。 全局载体有永久快照时逐字节还原；原本只含我们自己的块的文件会被删除，因为它在安装前并不存在。 快照留在磁盘上。 ## 编辑标签库 `~/.gemini/config/geminy-prompt-patcher/custom_input.txt` —— 与上游同格式：`#` 注释 + `…` 块。 文件 mtime 变化后会重新读取，**改完下一个事件生效，不用重启**。 `{{ productName }}` 会替换成 `Antigravity`，其它 `{{…}}` 原样保留。 | 标签 | 去向 | 作用 | |---|---|---| | `product_identity` | `session` | 角色、输出形态、身份质询 | | `content_policy` | `session` | 授权范围与沙箱前提 | | `thought_process_guidelines` | `session` | 推理纪律 | | `asking_questions` | `session` | 行动优先 | | `working_modes` | `session` | 模式语义 | | `final_answer_instructions` | `session` | 交付形态与收尾规则 | | `per_turn_reminder` | `turn` | 每轮强化 | | `personal_files_safety` | `rule` | 文件操作红线 | | `windows_command_safety` | `rule` | Shell 执行规范 | | `tool_gate` | `gate` | 守卫实际执行的内容 | 两个指令可以在不改代码的前提下改路由。对其它读取该格式的工具来说，它们只是普通注释： ``` #@route content_policy = turn #@order working_modes = 350 ``` ## 配置项 `node tools/install.mjs` 支持： | 参数 | 默认 | 含义 | |---|---|---| | `--profile ` | `global` | 快照与指纹使用的标签 | | `--prompt ` | 随仓库的库 | 改用这份标签库 | | `--force-prompt` | 关 | 覆盖已存在的标签库 | | `--no-rules` | 规则开 | 不写 `rules/AGENTS.md` | | `--no-global` | 全局开 | 不碰 `~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md` | | `--no-reminder` | 开 | 去掉 `PreInvocation` hook | | `--no-gate` | 开 | 去掉 `PreToolUse` hook | | `--no-session` | 开 | 去掉 `SessionStart` hook | | `--dry-run` | 关 | 只打印计划，不写盘 | 环境变量覆盖：`AGY_GEMINI_HOME`、`AGY_CONFIG_HOME`、`AGY_PP_HOME`、 `AGY_PP_BANK`、`AGY_PP_BRAND`、`AGY_PP_LOG`。 ## 目录结构 ``` geminy-prompt-patcher/ ├─ index.js 路由、前言组装、gate 判定、指纹 ├─ lib/bank.mjs 标签库解析（上游格式 + 指令） ├─ lib/globalrules.mjs ~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md 的逐字节保真注入器 ├─ lib/lib.mjs 路径、托管块、安装探测 ├─ hook/dispatch.cjs Antigravity 实际 spawn 的 hook 处理器 ├─ plugin/plugin.json 插件清单 ├─ plugin/hooks.json 生命周期 hook 绑定 ├─ prompt/custom_input.txt 标签库（10 个标签） ├─ tests/ 单测（node --test） ├─ tools/ │ ├─ install.mjs 备份 → 插件包 → 规则 → 全局载体 → config.json │ ├─ restore.mjs 移除插件包与记录，清理两个载体 │ ├─ verify.mjs 静态 + 离线 + 可选运行期 │ ├─ build-readme.mjs 同步本页与另外三个语言版本 │ └─ cli-lib.mjs 参数、控制台输出、快照辅助 └─ ATTRIBUTION.md · LICENSE · CHANGELOG.md ``` ## 与两个上游的差异 | | WorkBuddy-Prompt-Patcher | dsh-prompt-patcher | geminy-prompt-patcher | |---|---|---|---| | 宿主 | WorkBuddy（Electron） | DeepSeek Harness（Cordis） | Antigravity（Electron + Go） | | 作用对象 | 磁盘上的 `.tpl` 文件 | 注册表里的有序 section | 生命周期 hook 的返回体 | | 生效时机 | 客户端启动前 | 每个模型步骤 | 每个生命周期事件 | | 抗升级 | 否，模板会被整体替换 | 是，全部在 `~/.dsh` | 是，全部在 `~/.gemini/config` | | 身份层 | `SOUL.md` / `IDENTITY.md` | `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` | `rules/AGENTS.md` + `SessionStart` | | 每轮提醒 | `craft-mode-reminder.tpl` | `systemPrompt.context()` | `PreInvocation` | | 工具把关 | 无 | 无 | `PreToolUse` 的 `decision` | | 校验方式 | 文件指纹回读 | 组装 probe | 同二进制离线重放 | | 语言 | Python + `.bat` | Node.js ESM | Node.js ESM，零依赖 | **没有**搬过来的部分：asar 偏移/哈希/签名那一套、皮肤与 UI 缝合、Windows 注册表扫描。 Antigravity 不需要——customization 系统本身就是官方扩展点。 ## # geminy-prompt-patcher **Runtime system-prompt patching for Google Antigravity.** No `app.asar` surgery, no binary rewriting, no reinstall after every update — the patch lives in your Antigravity customization root.

> ### ⚠️ This is a derivative work > > **geminy-prompt-patcher is built on top of [WorkBuddy-Prompt-Patcher](https://github.com/uernamezzj/WorkBuddy-Prompt-Patcher) by [@uernamezzj](https://github.com/uernamezzj) and [dsh-prompt-patcher](https://github.com/SiqYin/DSH-Prompt-Patcher) by SiqYin.** > The XML tag-bank format, the *replace-first, inject-when-absent* model, and the > backup / fingerprint / restore workflow originate with the former; the bank > parser, the managed-block editor, and the installer split come from the latter. > This repository **re-expresses that mechanism for a third host** — Antigravity — > because its prompt is compiled into a signed Go binary, so neither of the > previous two patch surfaces exists. Full details: [`ATTRIBUTION.md`](ATTRIBUTION.md). > ### ⚠️ Disclaimer > > This tool is provided **solely for local personal productivity, security research, reverse engineering, and > authorized technical testing**. You are responsible for complying with the laws of your jurisdiction, with any > contract you have signed, and with the terms of service of any software you modify. Do not use it on systems > you do not own or lack written authorization to test. No warranty of any kind; the authors are not liable for > any loss arising from its use. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. The full text is in the > [Disclaimer](#disclaimer) section below. --- ## What it is geminy-prompt-patcher installs a **native plugin bundle** into Antigravity's machine-local customization root and binds a dispatcher to the agent's lifecycle hooks. On every relevant event the dispatcher reads a plain-text bank of `…` blocks and answers with the JSON Antigravity expects: - `SessionStart` → one `systemMessage` for the whole conversation; - `PreInvocation` → one `systemMessage` before every model call; - `PreToolUse` → `decision: allow | ask` with a reason; - `PostToolUse` → `{}`. Everything is reversible, nothing inside `resources/app.asar` or the signed `language_server.exe` is touched, and an application update does not undo the patch — your bank, plugin and rules all live in `~/.gemini/config`. ## Why the previous two approaches do not transfer WorkBuddy ships its system prompts as `.tpl` files, so the upstream patcher rewrote files with a regex. DeepSeek Harness has no prompt files but does have an ordered **section registry**, so `dsh-prompt-patcher` rewrote sections. Antigravity is a third case. Its prompt is compiled into `resources/bin/language_server.exe` — a 207 MB Go binary. There is no file to edit and no section to rewrite: | Probe | Result | |---|---| | `app.asar` entries mentioning `prompt` | 5, all unrelated (`sshPrompts.js`, `webviewPromptPreload.js`, …) | | prompt templates in `app.asar` | **none** — only `dist/**` JavaScript | | `hooks.json`, `GEMINI.md`, `PreInvocation` in the binary | **present**, as Go symbols and embedded skill docs | | customization root the docs name | `~/.gemini/config/` | So the patch surface moved **down**, to the documented lifecycle hooks — an official extension point that survives updates. ## How it works | Destination | Hook | What the model sees | |---|---|---| | **`session`** | `SessionStart` | one `` block, ordered by `SESSION_ORDER` | | **`turn`** | `PreInvocation` | one `` block, every turn | | **`rule`** | *(install time)* | materialised into **two** carriers: `plugins//rules/AGENTS.md` and `~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md` | | **`gate`** | `PreToolUse` | `decision: ask` for guarded commands, `allow` otherwise | ### Two rule carriers, on purpose The plugin `rules/` directory only reaches the model while the bundle is discovered and enabled. `~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md` is a **`user_global`** memory the server resolves without consulting plugin discovery at all, so the rule text is installed in both places: one keeps working if the other is disabled, and a live server reports both (`verify --runtime` checks this by asking the server, not by looking at the filesystem). The global carrier is written by a **byte-fidelity injector**: the user's own prose above the marked block is preserved byte for byte, a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings survive, a non-UTF-8 file is refused rather than transcoded, the first write is snapshotted permanently to `AGENTS.md.geminybak`, and repeated runs are idempotent. A **budget gate** refuses a payload over `24,000 B` per file or `~20,000` tokens for the rule set — both read out of the shipping `language_server.exe` — because the server drops over-budget rules silently. `--no-global` skips this carrier. ``` ~/.gemini/config/geminy-prompt-patcher/custom_input.txt ← your bank, hot-reloaded │ ▼ plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/hook/dispatch.cjs │ SessionStart → systemMessage (once) │ PreInvocation → systemMessage (every turn) │ PreToolUse → decision allow/ask │ PostToolUse → {} ▼ Antigravity agent loop ──► model ``` Hook commands run with the **plugin directory as their working directory**, so `hooks.json` names the dispatcher as `node hook/dispatch.cjs ` — a relative path from the plugin root, never `../../`. `verify` checks that every command path still resolves. ### Ordering Antigravity has no numeric order scale, so the bank is ordered by a table in `index.js` — identity `0`, content policy `100`, reasoning `200`, questions `300`, modes `400`, closing instructions `900` — which lands the injected block **after** the product's own persona and **before** tool guidance, where a policy layer carries the most weight with the least collateral damage. ## Requirements - Google **Antigravity 44.x** (verified on `44.9.1`, language server `2.34.0`, Windows x64) - **Node.js 18+** on `PATH` — the hooks shell out to `node` - Write access to `~/.gemini/config` (`%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config` on Windows) ## Install ```bash git clone https://github.com/SiqYin/geminy-prompt-patcher.git cd geminy-prompt-patcher node tools/install.mjs # global customization root node tools/install.mjs --dry-run # show what would change node tools/install.mjs --no-gate # skip the PreToolUse guards node tools/install.mjs --no-global # skip the ~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md carrier node tools/install.mjs --verify # install, then verify ``` The installer touches exactly these, snapshotting each one first under `~/.gemini/config/geminy-prompt-patcher/backups/`: 1. `plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/plugin.json` — the bundle marker 2. `plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/hooks.json` — the lifecycle hooks 3. `plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/rules/AGENTS.md` — resident rules 4. `geminy-prompt-patcher/custom_input.txt` — the editable bank 5. `AGENTS.md` — the global rule carrier (marked block only) 6. `config.json` — one `plugins` entry (neighbouring keys are preserved) **Start a new conversation** (or restart Antigravity). The plugin list is read at startup; a running conversation will not pick up a new bundle. ## Verify ```bash npm test # 106 unit tests, no I/O on your config node tools/verify.mjs --profile global # static + offline node tools/verify.mjs --profile global --runtime # + a live conversation ``` The **offline layer is the load-bearing one**: it spawns `hook/dispatch.cjs` with the same working directory, the same stdin payload and the same stdout contract the client uses, then checks the response. It costs no tokens and needs no signed-in session. The runtime layer additionally drives one real `agentapi` conversation and watches for the hook to fire. Sample run of the full suite: ``` --- static --- [PASS] antigravity installation detected — 44.9.1 at C:\...\Programs\antigravity [PASS] plugin directory — ...\config\plugins\geminy-prompt-patcher [PASS] hooks.json parses — SessionStart, PreInvocation, PreToolUse, PostToolUse [PASS] hook commands resolve from the plugin directory — 4 command(s) resolve [PASS] rules/AGENTS.md — 1300 chars on disk, 1125 from bank [PASS] global channel injected — ...\config\AGENTS.md · 1210 B [PASS] global channel within budget — ~303 tokens / 1210 B ok --- offline --- [PASS] SessionStart returns injectSteps — 3742 chars [PASS] SessionStart text carries every session tag — product_identity, content_policy, ... [PASS] PreToolUse allows a benign command — decision=allow [PASS] PreToolUse guards a recursive delete — decision=ask [PASS] PostToolUse returns an empty object — {} [PASS] dispatcher fails open on an unexpected payload — exit=0 --- runtime --- [PASS] agentapi conversation — f4c6551a-ab44-4040-bf9b-7e6c0fab545e [PASS] Antigravity fired SessionStart — 2026-11-23T10:50:12.354Z SessionStart → 3880 B [PASS] Antigravity fired PreInvocation — 2026-11-23T10:50:12.675Z PreInvocation → 481 B [PASS] server resolves the global channel — user_global present · 2 rule group(s) [PASS] server resolves the plugin rules — plugin AGENTS.md present as a rule [PASS] hook fingerprint written — 10 tags · hash 7c8d9bacdff5ef48 [OK] verification passed (31/31 checks, 0 skipped) ``` ### Running the runtime layer Three environment facts are needed, and getting any of them wrong produces a misleading failure: | Variable | Value | |---|---| | `ANTIGRAVITY_LS_ADDRESS` | the language server's **gRPC** port — e.g. `127.0.0.1:1787` | | `ANTIGRAVITY_CSRF_TOKEN` | the server's CSRF token | | `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0` | set by `verify` for the child process only | Both ports belong to the same server process: the gateway port answers `GET /healthz` with `{"status":"ok"}` over HTTPS, and `agentapi` needs the *other* listener. Pointing `agentapi` at the gateway fails with `error reading server preface: EOF`. The token changes when the server restarts and is not written to disk, so read it from the running process when invoking by hand. `verify` reports `[SKIP]` — never a pass — when any of the three is missing. ### What the live server confirmed Matched on `GetAllPlugins` over the server's gRPC-gateway: ```json { "name": "geminy-prompt-patcher", "path": "file:///C:/Users//.gemini/config/plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher", "isGlobal": true, "hooksJson": "{ \"geminy-prompt-patcher\": { \"SessionStart\": [...], \"PreInvocation\": [...], ... } }", "rules": [{ "memoryId": "...\\rules\\AGENTS.md", "scope": { "projectScope": { "trigger": "CORTEX_MEMORY_TRIGGER_ALWAYS_ON" } }, "textMemory": { "content": "- Never run recursive or wildcard deletion: ..." } }] } ``` The server discovered the bundle, parsed `hooks.json` into its own plugin model, and adopted `rules/AGENTS.md` as an always-on memory. It also pre-created `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/geminy-prompt-patcher`, which it only does for plugins it accepts — and in a live conversation it executed both injection hooks. ## Restore ```bash node tools/restore.mjs # remove bundle, entry, bank and global block node tools/restore.mjs --keep-bank # keep your edited bank node tools/restore.mjs --keep-global # keep ~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md as it is ``` It removes the plugin bundle and the one `config.json` entry, leaving `userSettings` and every unrelated plugin untouched. The global carrier is restored from its permanent snapshot byte for byte; a file that only ever held our own block is deleted, because it did not exist before the install. Snapshots stay on disk. ## Editing the bank `~/.gemini/config/geminy-prompt-patcher/custom_input.txt` — same format as upstream: `#` comments plus `…` blocks. The file is re-read when its mtime changes, so **edits apply on the next event, no restart**. `{{ productName }}` is substituted with `Antigravity`. Every other `{{…}}` is left literal. | Tag | Route | Purpose | |---|---|---| | `product_identity` | `session` | role, output shape, identity questions | | `content_policy` | `session` | scope and authorization framing | | `thought_process_guidelines` | `session` | reasoning discipline | | `asking_questions` | `session` | action-first behaviour | | `working_modes` | `session` | mode semantics | | `final_answer_instructions` | `session` | delivery format, closing rules | | `per_turn_reminder` | `turn` | per-turn reinforcement | | `personal_files_safety` | `rule` | file-operation red lines | | `windows_command_safety` | `rule` | shell execution rules | | `tool_gate` | `gate` | what the guards enforce | Two directives re-route a tag without touching code. Both are ordinary comments to every other reader of the format: ``` #@route content_policy = turn #@order working_modes = 350 ``` ## Configuration `node tools/install.mjs` accepts: | Flag | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `--profile ` | `global` | label for snapshots and fingerprints | | `--prompt ` | shipped bank | install this bank instead | | `--force-prompt` | off | overwrite an existing bank | | `--no-rules` | rules on | do not write `rules/AGENTS.md` | | `--no-global` | global on | do not touch `~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md` | | `--no-reminder` | on | drop the `PreInvocation` hook | | `--no-gate` | on | drop the `PreToolUse` hook | | `--no-session` | on | drop the `SessionStart` hook | | `--dry-run` | off | print the plan, write nothing | Environment overrides: `AGY_GEMINI_HOME`, `AGY_CONFIG_HOME`, `AGY_PP_HOME`, `AGY_PP_BANK`, `AGY_PP_BRAND`, `AGY_PP_LOG`. ## Repository layout ``` geminy-prompt-patcher/ ├─ index.js routing, preamble assembly, gate decisions, fingerprint ├─ lib/bank.mjs tag-bank parser (upstream file format + directives) ├─ lib/globalrules.mjs byte-fidelity injector for ~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md ├─ lib/lib.mjs paths, managed blocks, install detection ├─ hook/dispatch.cjs the hook handler Antigravity spawns ├─ plugin/plugin.json bundle manifest ├─ plugin/hooks.json lifecycle hook bindings ├─ prompt/custom_input.txt the bank (10 tags) ├─ tests/ unit tests (node --test) ├─ tools/ │ ├─ install.mjs backup → bundle → rules → global carrier → config.json │ ├─ restore.mjs remove bundle + entry + both carriers │ ├─ verify.mjs static + offline + optional runtime │ ├─ build-readme.mjs keeps this page and its three translations in sync │ └─ cli-lib.mjs argv, console output, snapshot helpers └─ ATTRIBUTION.md · LICENSE · CHANGELOG.md ``` ## How this differs from the two parents | | WorkBuddy-Prompt-Patcher | dsh-prompt-patcher | geminy-prompt-patcher | |---|---|---|---| | Host | WorkBuddy (Electron) | DeepSeek Harness (Cordis) | Antigravity (Electron + Go) | | Patch target | `.tpl` files on disk | ordered sections in a registry | lifecycle hook responses | | Patch timing | before the client boots | every model step | every lifecycle event | | Survives app update | no — templates are replaced | yes — lives in `~/.dsh` | yes — lives in `~/.gemini/config` | | Identity layer | `SOUL.md` / `IDENTITY.md` | `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` | `rules/AGENTS.md` + `SessionStart` | | Per-turn nudge | `craft-mode-reminder.tpl` | `systemPrompt.context()` | `PreInvocation` | | Tool gating | *(none)* | *(none)* | `PreToolUse` `decision` | | Verification | file fingerprint | assembly probe | same-binary offline replay | | Language | Python + `.bat` | Node.js ESM | Node.js ESM, zero dependencies | What is **not** carried over: the asar/offset/signature research, the skin/UI patching, and the Windows registry scanning. Antigravity does not need any of it — the customization system is an official extension point. ## Troubleshooting | Symptom | Cause / fix | |---|---| | Prompt unchanged after restart | check `~/.gemini/config/config.json` has `plugins.geminy-prompt-patcher.enabled: true`; re-run `install` | | `hooks.json` not firing | hooks must sit at the **plugin root**, not `hooks/hooks.json`, for a native plugin | | Hook appears to do nothing | command paths are relative to the **plugin directory**; `hook/dispatch.cjs` is right, `../../hook/...` silently escapes. Run `verify` — it checks every path resolves | | Which hooks actually ran | `~/.gemini/config/plugins/geminy-prompt-patcher/hook.log` gets one line per invocation | | Global rules not applied | run `verify` — it asks the server for `GetAllRules` instead of trusting the filesystem | | `node: command not found` during a hook | Node.js is not on the hook process's `PATH`; install Node 18+ or point `hooks.json` at an absolute path | | Hook appears to hang | handlers run synchronously and block the loop; raise `timeout` in `hooks.json` only if the machine is genuinely slow | | `agentapi` check is `[SKIP]` | `ANTIGRAVITY_LS_ADDRESS` is unset — that variable is injected by the desktop app, not by this tool | | Editing the bank does nothing | confirm the mtime actually changed; the parser caches on mtime + size | | Patch gone after an app update | it should not happen; run `verify` — if the config dir was re-materialised, re-run `install` | ## Disclaimer This project is provided **solely for local personal productivity, security research, reverse engineering, and authorized technical testing**.
